control_limitation: MO0 differs from historical M2 by best -0.03582426 and last -0.02780487. Same-source GPU short trajectories diverge, but the final 400-epoch R2 gap has not been quantitatively explained; a same-seed pair is not an uncertainty estimate.
raw_field_diagnostics: diagnostics/ (separate pending full-checkpoint delivery; do not infer complete from this summary)

interpretation.S2_vs_S1: Adds the zero-initialized query residual to S1 already-learned 3NN geometry-conditioned interpolation. Gains are from this conditional residual addition, not evidence that attention alone is beneficial.
interpretation.S3_vs_S4: Same total parameter count and matched initial state. Multiplicative gating has better IoU, case P10 and log_z fit in this run than additive modulation, with small physical R2 gain and mixed MAE behavior. Neither beats historical M2.
interpretation.S5: Doubling local branch width does not reach the physical gain floor versus MO0, loses case P10, and introduces a negative-R2 KANG_YONG case at last. Additional capacity does not automatically improve this recipe.
interpretation.S6: Adding an SA1 residual block improves physical R2 relative to this weaker MO0 but remains below historical M2 and violates case P10 protection. It is not a successful depth optimization in this run.
interpretation.selection: All six fail at least the historical physical R2 improvement floor. S1/S2/S3 pass all four other protection lines; S4/S5/S6 have additional P10 or negative-case failures. All raw results are retained.
